signed_rows.behavior: The docs and the bundle stay valid after the fixes: kmctl check passes on the repository.
signed_rows.fails_when: kmctl check reports a broken link, index or schema after the change

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl review due's and kmctl briefing's help say what the commands do now: review due lists docs/ pages as well as .okf/ concepts, and the commands reference quotes the help as the CLI prints it.
signed_rows.fails_when: review due's help still says it lists only .okf/ concepts, or the reference and the help disagree
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests -q -k "help or commands or reference"

signed_rows.behavior: The commit message lists every one of the 35 findings (spikes 2 to 4) as fixed, naming the changed file, or not real, with the evidence; decisions change only through Correction sections, their index lines through a note, and every touched concept has a .okf/log.md line.
signed_rows.fails_when: a finding is missing from the list, a fix is claimed for an unchanged file, a decision's body or description is rewritten, or a touched concept has no log line

signed_rows.behavior: The three audits ran once more on the result; any of the 35 that came back was checked again and fixed or recorded as not real, and new findings went to a follow-up stub.
signed_rows.fails_when: the rerun is missing, a returning finding is left unanswered, or a new finding is fixed in this ticket instead of a stub
